acceptanceCriteria: TestSelectionOnTheLiveDirtyWorktree passes with a dirty .github/cishards/order.go, and still fails for a DEPENDENCY_PATH witness that no rule produced.
body: Confirmed 2026-10-04 at 2b533372 (branch claude/v1-0717-main-reuse; macOS, go1.27.1). Reproduce: append a comment to .github/cishards/order.go and run `GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -count=1 ./internal/liveverify/affected`. Actual: measure_test.go:165 fails with `go:github.com/Beamfall/corvint/tools/corvint-pr-tests has an unresolvable witness {Kind:DEPENDENCY_PATH DirtyPath:.github/cishards/order.go Via:[...tools/corvint-pr-tests]}`. Expected: pass. Cause: .github/cishards is not a unit in the graph, so goSourceRule (structure.go) selects its importer through importsAbsentPackage with Via=[importer]; the test's final branch requires OwnerOf(DirtyPath)==Via[0] and has no case for that rule. Clean trees (CI) are unaffected; any developer or agent run with a dirty cishards file fails. Same test and defect class as V1-0564 (ENCLOSING_PACKAGE), different witness rule.
title: Affected live-worktree test rejects the absent-package DEPENDENCY_PATH witness when .github/cishards is dirty
